source_candidates.name: GoldBet fixture-level MMS stability and drift audit
quality_notes: 1X2 PP1 ROI differs materially between <360 and >=360 minute observations.
1X2 PP1 reverses materially between ordered temporal halves.
BTTS PP1 deteriorates materially in the later temporal half.
Subgroup reversals are classified as non-stationarity/confounding and require independent replication.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet 1X2 lead-time drift composition decomposition
quality_notes: The raw near-minus-far 1X2 PP1 ROI difference is -50.08 percentage points.
After pooled side-by-price-band standardization the difference is -56.04 points.
The 10,000-draw fixture bootstrap 95% interval is -82.97 to -28.96 points.
Persistence is classified as instability/confounding; all timing subgroups remain rejected.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet 1X2 residual drift competition and chronology audit
quality_notes: No country-by-side-by-price cell has sufficient observations in both lead groups.
Near observations are disproportionately EUROPE-labelled; far observations contain large England and Scotland blocks.
The early half retains a negative side-price adjusted difference, but competition confounding remains unresolved.
The late half has only one eligible side-price cell and is inconclusive.

source_candidates.name: GoldBet multi-snapshot pre-kickoff hygiene audit
quality_notes: All negative minutes-to-start snapshots are excluded before feature construction.
Twenty complete market groups meet the strict 20-40 minute T-30 window.
The T-30 groups cover only three fixtures and cannot support inference.
Last persisted pre-kickoff is not relabelled as CLOSE.
All 2,309 snapshot timestamps agree with stored minutes-to-start sign; future eligibility nevertheless requires both timestamp proofs.

goldbet_2026_exact_outcomes.rule: Exact Flashscore event ID only; require both regular halves; never use fuzzy match-score fields.

same_book_open_close.note: Fixture-level MMS thresholds remain rejected. Stability analysis finds material lead-time and temporal reversals, so pooled ROI is not interpretable without timing segmentation; observed-current remains non-CLOSE.

market_close_benchmark.rule: Benchmark market closing prices may support CLV/context only under their true bookmaker/source labels; they never substitute GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

intermediate_t30.rule: Never derive T-30 from CLOSE or interpolate absent timestamps. Preserve checkpoint distance and GOOD/FALLBACK quality.

pre_match_structural.anti_leakage: Features use strictly prior source dates; updates occur only after the complete date batch.
pre_match_structural.result: Elo robustly beats the development prior in Sweden, Norway, Netherlands and Portugal, but not in Denmark or 2. Bundesliga. Form/full bundles remain unpromoted in every league; external close significantly beats all structural variants in Portugal and 2. Bundesliga and remains non-GoldBet.
pre_match_structural.identity_gate: League-format integrity required before metrics: 16 teams/240 matches for Sweden-Norway; 12 teams/32 matches per club for Denmark; 18 teams/34 matches per club for Netherlands, Portugal and 2. Bundesliga.

quarantine_rules: prospective 2026 snapshots are not multi-season historical evidence
FIRST_SEEN cannot substitute TRUE OPEN in primary MMS tests
non-GoldBet bookmaker odds cannot be relabelled GoldBet
single-fixture proofs cannot support threshold promotion
sources without unambiguous fixture identity or timestamps are excluded
post-kickoff facts are outcome/evaluation data only

acceptance_gate.structural_rule: Only prior source dates may enter rolling features because source timezone is not documented.
acceptance_gate.market_rule: AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA are closing odds under the provider's documented C-column semantics; retain external benchmark class.
acceptance_gate.primary_mms_reason: Certified GoldBet TRUE OPEN exists and may generate MMS signals. Historical ROI/CLV promotion still requires observed close and outcome joins.
